set4-alex-019.text: You're learning. As long as it's actually coffee and not some synthetic sludge, you've just made my morning.

set4-alex-020.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-alex-020.text: Fine. Just let me know if it's a formal meeting or the kind where we should both be checking for exits before we sit down.

set4-alex-021.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-alex-021.text: I hope I was playing a role you actually liked. Or at least one that didn't involve me asking for a report.

set4-alex-022.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-alex-022.text: Let's just say I'm tired of the same scenery. Besides, you're a variable I haven't quite figured out yet, and that's more interesting than another day of playing house in Dogtown.

set4-alex-023.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-alex-023.text: That is a specific kind of message. He knows exactly who we are, and he decided we aren't worth the effort of a conversation. Right now, that is a win.

set4-alex-024.text: You don't have to. A drink or a quiet evening would be a much better thank you than a speech.

set4-alex-025.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-alex-025.text: Which one? If it's a good one, I might actually enjoy the distraction.

set4-alex-026.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-alex-026.text: I'm perfectly serious. It's a gamble, sure, but the alternative is just waiting for the floor to drop out from under us. Which one sounds better to you?

set4-alex-027.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-alex-027.text: That is a heavy thing to carry. I'm not exactly a pillar of stability, but I'm here. For now, that's all any of us can really offer.

set4-evelyn-parker-028.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-evelyn-parker-028.text: Whether the person I am talking to is actually as capable as they claim to be. It is a habit of mine to watch for the gap between a reputation and the reality.

set4-evelyn-parker-029.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-evelyn-parker-029.text: You borrowed it? I hope the stain is something that comes out easily. I would hate to have to charge you for a replacement.

set4-evelyn-parker-030.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-evelyn-parker-030.text: I never said I could. But I do know how to appreciate a meal that was not made in a factory.

set4-evelyn-parker-031.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-evelyn-parker-031.text: In this city, that is almost a greeting. The real question is whether they were trying to scare you, or simply letting you know they are coming.

set4-evelyn-parker-032.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-evelyn-parker-032.text: I like the opportunities. As for the city itself, I think it is a very convincing lie. Most people just prefer the lie to the alternative.

set4-evelyn-parker-033.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-evelyn-parker-033.text: That is a very personal question for such a casual conversation. I prefer to keep my worst days to myself.

set4-evelyn-parker-034.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-evelyn-parker-034.text: An apology is a start. Now I am curious to find out what exactly you think you did.

set4-evelyn-parker-035.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-evelyn-parker-035.text: I simply paid attention to the things everyone else was too busy to notice. Most people see what they expect to see, not what is actually there.

set4-evelyn-parker-036.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-evelyn-parker-036.text: I am not always serious. I am just observant. It is much easier to navigate the city when you are not distracted by your own noise.

set4-evelyn-parker-037.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-evelyn-parker-037.text: A table at the Afterlife? That is a useful bit of leverage. I hope you managed to get one that is not right next to the speakers.

set4-evelyn-parker-038.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-evelyn-parker-038.text: I do not believe in paths, only choices. I have made the choices that got me this far, and I am simply looking for the one that takes me where I actually want to go.

set4-evelyn-parker-039.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-evelyn-parker-039.text: I hear a lot of things in this city. Most of it is just noise. I would be more interested in who is telling you that, and why they want you to believe it.

set4-evelyn-parker-040.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-evelyn-parker-040.text: I prefer to get to the destination. If you find my style so distressing, you are more than welcome to take the wheel.

set4-evelyn-parker-041.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-evelyn-parker-041.text: I will try to contain my impulses. Just make sure you are actually coming back.

set4-evelyn-parker-042.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-evelyn-parker-042.text: Trusting the wrong person with a secret. In Night City, that is far more dangerous than any gunfight.

set4-evelyn-parker-043.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-evelyn-parker-043.text: You are asking for a favor while keeping me in the dark. That is a very expensive way to do business.

set4-evelyn-parker-044.player: You have something on your face.
set4-evelyn-parker-044.text: Do I? You will have to be more specific, or I will just assume you are trying to distract me.

set4-evelyn-parker-045.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-evelyn-parker-045.text: That is usually the moment when people start making mistakes. The question is whether you are looking for a way out, or just someone to hold your hand while you sink.

set4-evelyn-parker-046.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-evelyn-parker-046.text: Importance is a matter of perspective. I have been in rooms with people who think they own the world, but that does not make me one of them.

set4-evelyn-parker-047.text: How thoughtful. I hope it is actually coffee and not some synthetic substitute that tastes like burnt plastic.

set4-evelyn-parker-048.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-evelyn-parker-048.text: Then we will meet. I just wonder if he is calling us because he has a plan, or because he is starting to panic.

set4-evelyn-parker-049.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-evelyn-parker-049.text: Is that so? I hope for your sake it was a professional dream. I would hate to think I am occupying your subconscious for free.

set4-evelyn-parker-050.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-evelyn-parker-050.text: Because you are an interesting variable. And in a city where everything is scripted, I find it useful to be around someone who is unpredictable.

set4-evelyn-parker-051.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-evelyn-parker-051.text: A very deliberate choice. He wanted us to know that he saw us, and that we are not currently worth his time.

set4-evelyn-parker-052.text: You are welcome. Though I suspect a proper thank you usually comes with a reason, or perhaps a favor.

set4-evelyn-parker-053.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-evelyn-parker-053.text: Some melodies are designed to be parasites. Perhaps you should find something more productive to think about.

set4-evelyn-parker-054.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-evelyn-parker-054.text: I am perfectly serious. The risk is high, but the alternative is staying exactly where we are. I think we both know that is not an option.

set4-evelyn-parker-055.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-evelyn-parker-055.text: That is a heavy realization. I am not usually the person people lean on, but I am here.

set4-jackie-welles-056.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-jackie-welles-056.text: Honestly? Just thinking about how we're gonna make it to the big leagues, V. Imagine it, choom. The Afterlife, our names in lights, and enough eddies to make Mama proud.

set4-jackie-welles-057.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-jackie-welles-057.text: You what? V, tell me you didn't get some greasy street food all over the leather. Just give it here, I'll see if I can scrub it out.

set4-jackie-welles-058.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-jackie-welles-058.text: Who said I could cook? I just know what tastes good, hermano. If you want a real meal, you gotta visit Mama. Her sopa de fideos puts everything else in this city to shame.

set4-jackie-welles-059.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-jackie-welles-059.text: What? Who the hell thinks they can just walk up to your place and leave a note? Tell me everything. We'll figure out who's playing games and make sure they regret it.

set4-jackie-welles-060.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-jackie-welles-060.text: It is a meat grinder, V. No doubt about that. But it is my home. Heywood, the people, the noise... Plus, where else are you gonna find opportunities like the ones we are chasing?

set4-jackie-welles-061.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-jackie-welles-061.text: Man, you really want to go there? Let's just say there was a time when I thought I was untouchable, and the city decided to prove me wrong in the worst way possible. But hey, it's why I'm here now, and why I don't take the small wins for granted.

set4-jackie-welles-062.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-jackie-welles-062.text: Now you've got me curious. What'd you do this time, V? Just spit it out, choom.

set4-jackie-welles-063.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-jackie-welles-063.text: Ha! Told you I had it handled! Just a bit of timing and knowing exactly where to hit 'em. You gotta trust the process, hermano!

set4-jackie-welles-064.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-jackie-welles-064.text: Serious? Me? V, you've been spending too much time around those corporate suits. I'm the life of the party, choom!

set4-jackie-welles-065.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-jackie-welles-065.text: No way! You actually pulled it off? V, this is it! We are finally stepping into the big leagues. Let's get over there before they realize we don't belong yet!

set4-jackie-welles-066.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-jackie-welles-066.text: Sometimes, maybe. But look where it got me. I know the streets, I know the players, and I got you as a partner. I think I'm exactly where I need to be to make the big jump.

set4-jackie-welles-067.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-jackie-welles-067.text: What are you talking about? Who told you that? We haven't even hit the ground running yet. Don't listen to the street chatter, V. We've got a plan, and we're sticking to it.

set4-jackie-welles-068.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-jackie-welles-068.text: Terrible? You're just scared of a little speed, V! That's not bad driving, that's called style. Now hold on tight and stop complaining!

set4-jackie-welles-069.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-jackie-welles-069.text: Hey, who you calling stupid? Go on, get out of here. I'll be right here, behaving myself. Mostly.

set4-jackie-welles-070.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-jackie-welles-070.text: Man, in this city? That is a long list. But probably the first time I tried to play the big leagues without a proper crew. Let's just say I learned the hard way that being brave and being stupid are two very different things.

set4-jackie-welles-071.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-jackie-welles-071.text: Now that is a hell of a way to start a conversation. Look, I trust you, V. If you say it is that heavy, I believe you. Just tell me where to be and what to bring, and I got your back.

set4-jackie-welles-072.player: You have something on your face.
set4-jackie-welles-072.text: What? Where? Better not be another grease stain from that jacket. Just tell me, choom, is it something I can wipe off or do I need to see Viktor?

set4-jackie-welles-073.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-jackie-welles-073.text: Hey, look at me. We've both been there, V. That is just how it feels right before you make the big jump. You aren't in this alone, remember? We figure it out together, or we go down swinging.

set4-jackie-welles-074.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-jackie-welles-074.text: Important? I was a Valentino, V! Not the top dog, maybe, but I had respect in Heywood. Now, I'm just building the road to something even bigger. The real importance comes when the Afterlife remembers your name.

set4-jackie-welles-075.text: Now we're talking! You're a lifesaver, V. I was starting to see double. Let's drink up and get back to it.

set4-jackie-welles-076.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-jackie-welles-076.text: Tonight, huh? Hope he is bringing some good news and a fat paycheck. Let's get cleaned up and head out, I don't want to keep the man waiting.

set4-jackie-welles-077.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-jackie-welles-077.text: Oh yeah? Please tell me I was doing something legendary, like walking into the Afterlife with a mountain of eddies. Come on, V, don't leave me hanging!

set4-jackie-welles-078.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-jackie-welles-078.text: Why? Because you're my choom, V. In a city where everyone is just looking for a way to use you, having someone you can actually trust? That is worth more than any payout. Plus, we're gonna be legends together.

set4-jackie-welles-079.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-jackie-welles-079.text: He did what? The nerve of this guy! Maybe he's just trying to play it cool, but nobody just walks away from us. We'll see how he feels when we're the ones holding the cards.

set4-jackie-welles-080.text: For what? You don't have to do that, V. We're a team. But hey, if you're feeling generous, I wouldn't say no to a round of drinks later!

set4-jackie-welles-081.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-jackie-welles-081.text: Which one? The one that sounds like a blender in a trash compactor? Just hum it out, choom, or put some real music on before it drives us both crazy.

set4-jackie-welles-082.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-jackie-welles-082.text: What do you mean? It's a solid plan, V! A little risk, a lot of reward. That is how you get your name in the history books. Trust me, we got this.

set4-jackie-welles-083.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-jackie-welles-083.text: Damn, V. I'm sorry. Just remember, I ain't going anywhere. You got me, and that is enough to get us through whatever comes next.

set4-johnny-silverhand-084.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-johnny-silverhand-084.text: Just wondering how much of this city is actually standing and how much is just held together by corporate glue and desperation. It's a hell of a view if you like watching a slow-motion train wreck.

set4-johnny-silverhand-085.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-johnny-silverhand-085.text: You did what? I don't care about the stain, V, but you don't just walk off with a man's gear. Just make sure it still fits when you give it back.

set4-johnny-silverhand-086.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-johnny-silverhand-086.text: I didn't. But knowing how to keep yourself fed without relying on a vending machine is just basic survival. Don't go expecting a five-course meal.

set4-johnny-silverhand-087.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-johnny-silverhand-087.text: A threat. In this city, that's practically a greeting card. You know who it is, or are we just guessing who's got a grudge today?

set4-johnny-silverhand-088.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-johnny-silverhand-088.text: Like it? It's a neon-lit sewer where the only thing cheaper than the chrome is the people. I love the fight, V. The city itself? It's just the cage we're trying to break.

set4-johnny-silverhand-089.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-johnny-silverhand-089.text: You want the highlight reel of my failures? There are a few candidates. Mexico, for one. Seeing the corporate machine grind people into the dirt while the suits got medals for it. Then there's the day I decided to take the fight to Arasaka and ended up as a ghost in a chip. Pick your poison.

set4-johnny-silverhand-090.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-johnny-silverhand-090.text: Now that's a first. Go ahead. Let's see if you can actually say it without making it about yourself.

set4-johnny-silverhand-091.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-johnny-silverhand-091.text: I can't see what you're looking at, V. You're going to have to describe it or turn your vision on if you want me to take credit for it.

set4-johnny-silverhand-092.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-johnny-silverhand-092.text: Serious? I'm the most entertaining thing in your head. Maybe you're just used to the corporate drones who smile while they're stabbing you in the back.

set4-johnny-silverhand-093.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-johnny-silverhand-093.text: A table at the Afterlife. Not bad. Let's see if the drinks are still as overpriced as the egos in that place.

set4-johnny-silverhand-094.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-johnny-silverhand-094.text: Every day I'm a ghost, I think about it. But the alternative was playing by their rules, wearing a tie, and pretending the world wasn't burning. I'd rather be a memory with a grudge than a corporate suit with a soul for sale.

set4-johnny-silverhand-095.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-johnny-silverhand-095.text: Wrong is one way to put it. It went exactly how Arasaka wanted it to go. I remember it my way, but if you're looking for a certified history lesson, you're talking to the wrong ghost.

set4-johnny-silverhand-096.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-johnny-silverhand-096.text: I'm a passenger in your skull, V. If we're hitting walls, that's on your hands. Maybe you're just not used to having a real critic in the seat next to you.

set4-johnny-silverhand-097.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-johnny-silverhand-097.text: No promises. Just don't take too long. I'm getting bored just standing here.

set4-johnny-silverhand-098.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-johnny-silverhand-098.text: Walking into Arasaka Tower with a dream and a detonator. Most people call it a suicide mission. I called it a Tuesday. Turns out, the only thing more dangerous than the job was the guy they sent to clean up the mess.

set4-johnny-silverhand-099.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-johnny-silverhand-099.text: Now we're playing games. Fine by me. I've spent half my life keeping secrets from people who didn't deserve to know them. Just tell me where to point the gun.

set4-johnny-silverhand-100.player: You have something on your face.
set4-johnny-silverhand-100.text: I can't see right now, V. You're going to have to describe it or turn your vision on if you want me to fix it.

set4-johnny-silverhand-101.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-johnny-silverhand-101.text: Welcome to the club. That's usually where the real work starts. Either you learn how to swim in the deep end, or you let the current drag you under. Which one is it gonna be?

set4-johnny-silverhand-102.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-johnny-silverhand-102.text: Important? Depends on who you ask. To the suits, I was a nuisance with a loud guitar. To the people who actually gave a damn, I was a spark. I wasn't looking to be important, V. I just wanted to burn the right things down.

set4-johnny-silverhand-103.text: I can't see what you're holding, V. Unless you've figured out how to upload the smell of caffeine into an engram, you're just talking to yourself.

set4-johnny-silverhand-104.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-johnny-silverhand-104.text: A fixer. Hope they've got something better than another errand for some mid-level suit. Let's see if the payout is actually worth the risk this time.

set4-johnny-silverhand-105.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-johnny-silverhand-105.text: A dream. Hope I was doing something useful, like blowing up a corporate headquarters. Or maybe I was just telling you your taste in music is garbage. Which one was it?

set4-johnny-silverhand-106.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-johnny-silverhand-106.text: I didn't exactly pack a bag and buy a ticket, V. We're tied together by a piece of corporate hardware. But if you're asking if I'm glad I'm here... let's just say it's better than rotting in a server farm.

set4-johnny-silverhand-107.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-johnny-silverhand-107.text: Who? You're going to have to be more specific, V. I can't see who you're talking about.

set4-johnny-silverhand-108.text: Don't start getting sentimental on me now. A drink or a decent lead on a job is thanks enough. Save the speech for someone who actually cares about the etiquette.

set4-johnny-silverhand-109.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-johnny-silverhand-109.text: Which one? If it's one of Kerry's kitschy ballads, I can't blame you for the mental scarring. If it's Samurai, just lean into it. Let it burn.

set4-johnny-silverhand-110.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-johnny-silverhand-110.text: I'm dead serious. It's risky, it's messy, and it'll probably blow up in our faces. That's why it's the only way that actually works. You want a safe plan, go get a job at a vending machine.

set4-johnny-silverhand-111.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-johnny-silverhand-111.text: That's the way of the city, V. It eats everything until there's nothing left but the ghosts. I'm not exactly the best company, but I'm the only one who knows exactly how it feels to be the last one standing.

set4-judy-alvarez-112.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-judy-alvarez-112.text: Just wondering if I can tweak the sensory profile on a project I'm working on without making the whole thing feel like a fever dream. It's a fine line between a vivid experience and just giving the viewer a headache.

set4-judy-alvarez-113.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-judy-alvarez-113.text: You what? Great. Just tell me it's something that actually comes out with a scrub and not some corporate-grade chemical spill.

set4-judy-alvarez-114.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-judy-alvarez-114.text: I didn't. Though, looking at this outfit, I guess it's a pretty loud hint. Don't get your hopes up, though. I'm better with a soldering iron than a frying pan.

set4-judy-alvarez-115.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-judy-alvarez-115.text: A threat? Who the hell is it, and did they actually say something, or just leave some vague, creepy warning?

set4-judy-alvarez-116.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-judy-alvarez-116.text: Like it? No. But I've got my workshop, my friends, and I'm not some corporate puppet. In this city, that's about as close to winning as you get.

set4-judy-alvarez-117.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-judy-alvarez-117.text: That's a heavy question for a Tuesday. I don't know if I'm in the mood to dive into that right now. Maybe some other time.

set4-judy-alvarez-118.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-judy-alvarez-118.text: Oh yeah? I'm listening. What exactly are you apologizing for?

set4-judy-alvarez-119.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-judy-alvarez-119.text: Glad you liked it. It's all in the layers. I just stripped out the noise and calibrated the sensory profile so it hits you where it's supposed to without overloading your system.

set4-judy-alvarez-120.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-judy-alvarez-120.text: Always? Maybe because I spend half my life staring at raw sensory data and the other half making sure people don't get chewed up by this city. I can lighten up, just give me a reason to.

set4-judy-alvarez-121.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-judy-alvarez-121.text: The Afterlife? I didn't think you had the kind of pull to just snag a table there. I'm game, but don't expect me to start acting like some high-roller just because we're in the room.

set4-judy-alvarez-122.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-judy-alvarez-122.text: Sometimes. I mean, the money in the corporate studios is insane. But then I think about who would be calling the shots on my work, and yeah, I'm good right where I am.

set4-judy-alvarez-123.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-judy-alvarez-123.text: The Arasaka job? I've heard a few things, but you know how rumors fly in this city. Did it actually go south, or is this just more noise?

set4-judy-alvarez-124.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-judy-alvarez-124.text: Oh, really? I'm a tech, not a getaway driver. As long as we get there in one piece, I figure I'm doing just fine.

set4-judy-alvarez-125.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-judy-alvarez-125.text: Who says I'm the one doing something stupid? Go on, then. I'll be right here.

set4-judy-alvarez-126.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-judy-alvarez-126.text: Probably the stuff I did back at Clouds. Not the technical side, but the people side. Getting involved with the dolls, trying to actually help them while the management was breathing down our necks. In this city, caring about the wrong people is the most dangerous thing you can do.

set4-judy-alvarez-127.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-judy-alvarez-127.text: Now that is a great start. Look, I'm usually down to help, but I don't like flying blind. If you can't tell me why, at least tell me if I'm going to end up with a MaxTac squad at my door because of it.

set4-judy-alvarez-128.player: You have something on your face.
set4-judy-alvarez-128.text: What? Where? Just tell me if it's grease or something worse.

set4-judy-alvarez-129.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-judy-alvarez-129.text: We've all been there. Just take a breath. Tell me what's happening, and we'll figure out a way to pull you back out before you drown.

set4-judy-alvarez-130.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-judy-alvarez-130.text: Important? I don't know about that. I've had my share of connections and I'm good at what I do, but I've never been interested in being some big name. I'd rather be the one actually fixing things from the basement.

set4-judy-alvarez-131.text: Now we're talking. You're officially back in my good books. Just put it over there before I forget I'm actually working.

set4-judy-alvarez-132.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-judy-alvarez-132.text: Which one? Depending on who it is, I might need to decide if I'm actually in the mood for whatever mess they're about to drag us into.

set4-judy-alvarez-133.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-judy-alvarez-133.text: Oh yeah? Was I actually doing something useful, or was it just some weird Night City fever dream?

set4-judy-alvarez-134.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-judy-alvarez-134.text: Maybe I just figured you were too reckless to handle yourself. Or maybe I just wanted to see where this was actually going. Either way, I'm here.

set4-judy-alvarez-135.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-judy-alvarez-135.text: Just walked away? Either he's got a lot of nerve, or he knows something we don't. Which one do you think it is?

set4-judy-alvarez-136.text: You don't have to. Just knowing you're still standing is thanks enough. Besides, I didn't do it for a thank you.

set4-judy-alvarez-137.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-judy-alvarez-137.text: Which one? If it's one of those corporate jingles, I might have to charge you for the mental damage.

set4-judy-alvarez-138.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-judy-alvarez-138.text: Why not? It's a bit messy, sure, but in this city, the clean plans are usually the ones that get you killed. It's the gaps in the logic where we actually find a way in.

set4-judy-alvarez-139.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-judy-alvarez-139.text: I'm sorry. I know that feeling all too well. Just know you're not alone. I'm not going anywhere.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-140.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-140.text: Just wondering if the label's actually going to let me tweak that bridge in the second track, or if they're just going to tell me it's perfect as it is. God, I hate it when they use the word perfect.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-141.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-141.text: You did what? V, tell me that stain is something that comes out with a little soap and not some permanent Night City cocktail.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-142.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-142.text: Well, you know, a man's gotta have a few tricks that don't involve a guitar. Keeps me sane when the industry tries to feed me nothing but corporate hors d'oeuvres.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-143.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-143.text: A threat? Look, I've dealt with my share of psychos and obsessed fans, but that's a different kind of headache. You okay, or do we need to figure out who's playing this game?

set4-kerry-eurodyne-144.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-144.text: It's a disaster, V. A loud, neon-soaked disaster. But it's my disaster. Still gives me something to write about, and honestly, I don't think I'd know how to breathe anywhere else.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-145.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-145.text: That's a heavy question for a Tuesday, V. I've had plenty of days where everything just fell apart, but usually, it's the slow burn that gets you more than one single bad day. Maybe some other time.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-146.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-146.text: Now I'm curious. Go ahead, V. Lay it on me.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-147.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-147.text: Right? Just a bit of timing and knowing exactly when to let the silence do the heavy lifting. You've got to give the notes room to breathe, otherwise it's just noise.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-148.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-148.text: Always? I'm the guy in the sequins, V. If you think this is me being serious, you've been listening to the wrong albums.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-149.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-149.text: A table at the Afterlife? Now that is a miracle. I'm in. Just make sure the drinks are actually cold and the music isn't some corporate loop.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-150.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-150.text: Sometimes. I wonder who I'd be if I hadn't chased the noise. But then I pick up the guitar and the thought just... vanishes. I can't imagine a version of me that doesn't play.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-151.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-151.text: The Arasaka job? I don't keep a close eye on every corporate heist in the city, V. As long as it didn't blow up my studio, I'm usually not in the loop.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-152.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-152.text: I'm not driving for the precision, V, I'm driving for the feeling. Besides, as long as we get there in one piece, the route is just a suggestion.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-153.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-153.text: No promises, V. I'll try to keep the chaos to a minimum until you get back.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-154.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-154.text: Probably the early days with Samurai. Playing in venues where the crowd was more likely to throw a bottle at your head than clap for the encore. Pure adrenaline, really. Terrifying, but it made the music feel like it actually mattered.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-155.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-155.text: Now that's a hell of a way to start a conversation. Look, I've always had a soft spot for a mystery, and I trust you. Just tell me where to be and what I'm bringing.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-156.player: You have something on your face.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-156.text: What? Where? If it's a smudge of makeup from the last shoot, just tell me. I can't have the public thinking I've forgotten how to use a mirror.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-157.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-157.text: We've all been there, V. Just take a breath. Tell me what's happening, or if you can't, just tell me how I can help you get your head back above water.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-158.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-158.text: Important? That's a funny way to put it. I've had the fame and the records, sure, but I'd rather be known for the music than some title. I'm still the same guy, just with a few more wrinkles and a lot more gear.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-159.text: Now we're talking. Tell me it's a double espresso, Jamaican blend, no sugar. If it is, you're officially my favorite person in this city today.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-160.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-160.text: A fixer? I'm not exactly in the habit of taking meetings with the underworld these days, but for you, I'll make an exception. Just let me know if I need to bring a guitar or a gun.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-161.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-161.text: Oh yeah? I hope I was playing something legendary and not just standing around looking confused. Come on, V, give me the details.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-162.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-kerry-eurodyne-162.text: Because you're real, V. In a city where everyone's playing a part or selling a version of themselves, you're just you. That's worth a lot more than a paycheck or a publicity stunt.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-163.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-163.text: Just walked away? Either he's got a lot of nerve, or he knows something we don't. Either way, it's a hell of a way to end a conversation.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-164.text: You don't have to, V. Just knowing you're still kicking is thanks enough. Besides, I didn't do it for the credit.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-165.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-165.text: That's the goal, V. Once it gets under your skin, it's not leaving. Just tell me which part is looping, and maybe I'll play it for you so you can finally get some sleep.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-166.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-166.text: Why not? The best parts of life usually happen when the plan is a complete disaster. Trust me, V, the chaos is where the real magic is.

set4-kerry-eurodyne-167.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-kerry-eurodyne-167.text: I'm sorry, V. I know I'm not exactly the most stable guy in the room, but I'm here. I'm not going anywhere.

set4-meredith-stout-168.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-meredith-stout-168.text: How to resolve a few operational headaches without leaving a trail. Why are you asking?

set4-meredith-stout-169.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-meredith-stout-169.text: You did what? Give it back. Now.

set4-meredith-stout-170.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-meredith-stout-170.text: I don't recall mentioning it. Who told you?

set4-meredith-stout-171.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-meredith-stout-171.text: That happens to people in this city. Unless you have a reason to believe it involves me, it is not my concern.

set4-meredith-stout-172.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-meredith-stout-172.text: I don't need to like it. I just need it to be functional enough for me to get my work done.

set4-meredith-stout-173.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-meredith-stout-173.text: I don't share my personal history for the sake of conversation. If you have something useful to discuss, start with that.

set4-meredith-stout-174.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-meredith-stout-174.text: I prefer results over apologies. If you have a way to make things right, I am listening.

set4-meredith-stout-175.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-meredith-stout-175.text: I don't know what you are referring to. Be specific.

set4-meredith-stout-176.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-meredith-stout-176.text: Because the people I deal with usually have a habit of making expensive mistakes. I prefer to stay focused.

set4-meredith-stout-177.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-meredith-stout-177.text: A table at the Afterlife is not easy to come by. I hope you have a professional reason for the invitation.

set4-meredith-stout-178.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-meredith-stout-178.text: Regret is a waste of time. I chose the path that gave me the most leverage.

set4-meredith-stout-179.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-meredith-stout-179.text: You seem well informed. Where did that come from?

set4-meredith-stout-180.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-meredith-stout-180.text: Watch your tone. I get where I need to go. If you have a problem with my driving, you are welcome to walk.

set4-meredith-stout-181.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-meredith-stout-181.text: I don't do stupid. Just make sure you are actually coming back.

set4-meredith-stout-182.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-meredith-stout-182.text: My job involves managing risks that would make most people panic. I don't categorize my work by how dangerous it is, only by whether it was successful.

set4-meredith-stout-183.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-meredith-stout-183.text: Then you are wasting my time. I don't provide help based on blind trust. Give me a reason to be interested, or find someone else.

set4-meredith-stout-184.player: You have something on your face.

set4-meredith-stout-185.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-meredith-stout-185.text: Most people are. The question is whether you have a plan to get out, or if you are just looking for someone to hold your hand.

set4-meredith-stout-186.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-meredith-stout-186.text: Importance is relative. I am exactly where I need to be to maintain control over my interests.

set4-meredith-stout-187.text: I hope it is black. Set it down and tell me why you are here.

set4-meredith-stout-188.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-meredith-stout-188.text: Which fixer? And why are we being grouped together for this meeting?

set4-meredith-stout-189.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-meredith-stout-189.text: I am not interested in your subconscious. Keep the conversation professional.

set4-meredith-stout-190.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-meredith-stout-190.text: Because you have access to information or assets that I find useful. Do not mistake a business arrangement for something else.

set4-meredith-stout-191.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-meredith-stout-191.text: Then he is either arrogant or he has already decided we are not worth the effort. Either way, it is a waste of time.

set4-meredith-stout-192.text: You don't need to. A successful outcome is the only thanks I require.

set4-meredith-stout-193.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-meredith-stout-193.text: I fail to see how that is relevant to anything we are doing. Focus.

set4-meredith-stout-194.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-meredith-stout-194.text: I am. If you have a more efficient way to achieve the result, I am listening. Otherwise, stop complaining and do your part.

set4-meredith-stout-195.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-meredith-stout-195.text: I am not a shoulder to cry on. If you are still standing, then focus on what you can actually control.

set4-panam-palmer-196.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-panam-palmer-196.text: Just wondering how long it takes for the city to actually swallow someone whole. It is a lot of noise for a place that feels this empty.

set4-panam-palmer-197.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-panam-palmer-197.text: You did what? I hope for your sake that stain comes out, V. That jacket has seen me through more dust storms than you have seen skyscrapers.

set4-panam-palmer-198.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-panam-palmer-198.text: I never said I could. I just know how to make something edible over a campfire without burning the camp down. Do not expect a five course meal.

set4-panam-palmer-199.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-panam-palmer-199.text: A threat? Tell me exactly what it says. If someone is bold enough to leave a note, they are either very confident or very stupid.

set4-panam-palmer-200.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-panam-palmer-200.text: Like it? No. It is suffocating. I can handle the danger, but the feeling of being trapped by walls and concrete is something I will never get used to.

set4-panam-palmer-201.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-panam-palmer-201.text: I would rather not. Some things are better left in the rearview mirror. Let us talk about something else.

set4-panam-palmer-202.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-panam-palmer-202.text: An apology? That is a first. Go on then, I am listening.

set4-panam-palmer-203.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-panam-palmer-203.text: It is all in the timing and knowing exactly where the breaking point is. You just have to stop overthinking it and drive.

set4-panam-palmer-204.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-panam-palmer-204.text: I am not always serious. I just prefer to be focused when things are actually happening. Besides, someone has to make sure we do not end up as a smudge on the pavement.

set4-panam-palmer-205.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-panam-palmer-205.text: The Afterlife? I have heard the stories, but I am not sure I want to spend my evening in a place that feels more like a corporate lobby than a bar. Still, if you managed to get a table, I suppose it is worth seeing for myself.

set4-panam-palmer-206.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-panam-palmer-206.text: I have had my share of arguments with Saul about which way to go. But the road is the only place that ever felt honest to me. I do not regret the path, just the people who tried to tell me how to walk it.

set4-panam-palmer-207.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-panam-palmer-207.text: I heard something similar. In this city, a job going wrong is practically a tradition. Do you know who actually survived the mess?

set4-panam-palmer-208.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-panam-palmer-208.text: A terrible driver? You have some nerve. I have navigated dunes that would make your head spin while you were still learning how to use a blinker. Try to keep up next time.

set4-panam-palmer-209.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-panam-palmer-209.text: I will be here. Just make sure you are the one coming back and not some corporate suit trying to pretend they know you.

set4-panam-palmer-210.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-panam-palmer-210.text: I have spent my whole life on the road, V. Between the Raffen Shiv and the corporate security we have run into, danger is just part of the scenery. But if you mean the most reckless, probably the time I decided I knew better than Saul and tried to handle a situation my own way. That is where the real risk was.

set4-panam-palmer-211.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-panam-palmer-211.text: You need my help, but you cannot tell me why. That is a dangerous way to start a deal, V. I do not like flying blind into a situation, especially when I am the one providing the backup.

set4-panam-palmer-212.player: You have something on your face.
set4-panam-palmer-212.text: What? Where? If this is some kind of joke, it is not a very good one.

set4-panam-palmer-213.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-panam-palmer-213.text: It happens to the best of us. Just tell me where you are stuck. We will figure out a way to pull you back out before you drown.

set4-panam-palmer-214.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-panam-palmer-214.text: Important? I have never cared about titles or being some kind of figurehead. I care about my family and making sure we have a future. If that makes me important, then sure. Otherwise, I am just a woman who knows how to drive and shoot.

set4-panam-palmer-215.text: Now you are talking. I was starting to think the only thing this city produced was smog and bad attitudes. Thanks, V.

set4-panam-palmer-216.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-panam-palmer-216.text: Which one? I hope it is not Rogue. I have had enough of her judgment to last me a lifetime. Tell me the place and the time, and I will be there.

set4-panam-palmer-217.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-panam-palmer-217.text: You did? I hope it was not one of those nightmares where we are trapped in a corporate office for eternity. Tell me, was I actually driving for once, or were you trying to take the wheel?

set4-panam-palmer-218.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-panam-palmer-218.text: Because you are competent, V. And because I have a feeling that you are one of the few people in this city who actually means what they say. That is a rare thing to find.

set4-panam-palmer-219.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-panam-palmer-219.text: He just walked away? Either he is incredibly arrogant, or he knows something we do not. I do not like being ignored.

set4-panam-palmer-220.text: You do not need to. We are past the point of formal thanks. Just have my back when the shooting starts, and we will call it even.

set4-panam-palmer-221.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-panam-palmer-221.text: Which one? If it is one of those corporate pop tracks they blast on every street corner, I suggest you find a way to scrub it out of your head. It is a special kind of torture.

set4-panam-palmer-222.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-panam-palmer-222.text: I am perfectly serious. It is a direct approach, and in my experience, that is the only way to keep people from overthinking themselves into a grave. If you have a better idea, say it now, or get in the car.

set4-panam-palmer-223.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-panam-palmer-223.text: I know that feeling. It is a heavy kind of silence. But you are not alone now. I am still here, and I am not going anywhere.

set4-river-ward-224.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-river-ward-224.text: Just wondering if I can actually get a decent night of sleep without some new crisis popping up. It's a rare thing in this city.

set4-river-ward-225.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-river-ward-225.text: You did? Don't worry about it. It's just a jacket, and in this city, a few stains are practically a requirement.

set4-river-ward-226.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-river-ward-226.text: I didn't think it was a particular skill. I can make a mean jambalaya, though. Just as long as I remember to keep stirring so I don't burn the pot.

set4-river-ward-227.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-river-ward-227.text: A threat? Let me see it. We need to figure out if this is just some low-life trying to rattle you or something we actually need to worry about.

set4-river-ward-228.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-river-ward-228.text: It's a hell of a city to live in. Most days it feels like it's trying to chew you up. But there are parts of it, and people in it, that make it worth sticking around.

set4-river-ward-229.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-river-ward-229.text: I don't usually go there. Let's just say there were people who broke into my house when I was a kid, and the people who were supposed to find the ones responsible... they didn't. That's why I joined the force. I didn't want other people to just be forgotten.

set4-river-ward-230.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-river-ward-230.text: For what? You don't have to apologize for everything, V. Just tell me what's on your mind.

set4-river-ward-231.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-river-ward-231.text: I'm not sure what you're referring to. I can't see what you're looking at right now, so you'll have to describe it to me.

set4-river-ward-232.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-river-ward-232.text: I'm not always serious. It just comes with the territory when you spend your days dealing with the worst parts of this city. I can relax, I just have to remember how.

set4-river-ward-233.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-river-ward-233.text: The Afterlife? I didn't think it was that easy to get a spot in there. I'm game, but I have a feeling the drinks are going to cost me a fortune.

set4-river-ward-234.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-river-ward-234.text: Sometimes. The badge takes a lot out of you, and it doesn't always let you do the right thing. But if I hadn't, I wouldn't have the tools to help the people I care about. I can live with that trade.

set4-river-ward-235.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-river-ward-235.text: I've heard a few things, but the rumors in this city usually have a way of twisting the truth. If you were involved, you're the one I should be asking.

set4-river-ward-236.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-river-ward-236.text: Hey, I get us from point A to point B in one piece, don't I? If you're that worried about it, feel free to take the wheel next time.

set4-river-ward-237.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-river-ward-237.text: I'll try my best. Just hurry back.

set4-river-ward-238.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-river-ward-238.text: Probably some of the calls I took early in my career, thinking the badge made me invincible. Realizing that a piece of tin doesn't stop a bullet or a knife... that was the dangerous part. Now I just make sure I've got a plan before I walk through the door.

set4-river-ward-239.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-river-ward-239.text: That's a hell of a way to start a request. I'm in, but you should know that going in blind makes it a lot harder for me to keep you safe. Just tell me where and when.

set4-river-ward-240.player: You have something on your face.
set4-river-ward-240.text: Where? I can't see it. You're just going to have to tell me if it's something I can wipe off or if I need to go find a mirror.

set4-river-ward-241.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-river-ward-241.text: We've both been there. Just take a breath and tell me what's happening. We'll figure out a way to pull you back out.

set4-river-ward-242.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-river-ward-242.text: Important? I've had a title and a badge, and I worked hard to earn them. But in a city like this, importance is usually just a fancy word for having a bigger target on your back.

set4-river-ward-243.text: Now we're talking. I can't see it, but I can definitely smell it. Thanks, V.

set4-river-ward-244.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-river-ward-244.text: Which one? Depending on who it is, I'll either be bringing my notebook or my gun. Let me know the place.

set4-river-ward-245.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-river-ward-245.text: You did? I hope it wasn't me lecturing you about police procedure. I'm curious now, but I'll let you decide if you actually want to tell me about it.

set4-river-ward-246.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-river-ward-246.text: Because you're a good person, V. And in a place like Night City, someone who actually gives a damn is worth sticking by.

set4-river-ward-247.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-river-ward-247.text: He did? Either he's not intimidated, or he knows something we don't. Let's keep an eye on him and see where he's heading.

set4-river-ward-248.text: You don't have to. Helping you out is enough for me. Just keep your head down and stay safe.

set4-river-ward-249.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-river-ward-249.text: Which one? Some of those corporate tracks are designed to do that. Just try to find something else to focus on before it drives you crazy.

set4-river-ward-250.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-river-ward-250.text: It's not a perfect plan, I'll give you that. But it's the only one we've got that doesn't involve us walking straight into a meat grinder. What's your better idea?

set4-river-ward-251.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-river-ward-251.text: I'm sorry, V. I know I'm not much, but I'm not going anywhere. You're not alone in this.

set4-rogue-amendiares-252.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-rogue-amendiares-252.text: How many people in this city are actually competent, and how many are just good at pretending.

set4-rogue-amendiares-253.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-rogue-amendiares-253.text: You borrowed it? Just make sure the bill for the cleaning is paid before you try to give it back.

set4-rogue-amendiares-254.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-rogue-amendiares-254.text: I didn't. I'm not in the habit of listing my hobbies.

set4-rogue-amendiares-255.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-rogue-amendiares-255.text: Who is it, and what did they want? Give me the details without the drama.

set4-rogue-amendiares-256.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-rogue-amendiares-256.text: I like the control. The city itself is just a machine that eats people who don't know how to play the game.

set4-rogue-amendiares-257.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-rogue-amendiares-257.text: That stays between me and the ghosts. An old story isn't public property just because I survived it.

set4-rogue-amendiares-258.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-rogue-amendiares-258.text: I'm listening. Just make sure it's an apology and not a lead-in to asking for a favor.

set4-rogue-amendiares-259.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-rogue-amendiares-259.text: Experience. And knowing exactly where to hit so the other side doesn't have time to react.

set4-rogue-amendiares-260.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-rogue-amendiares-260.text: Because in my line of work, the people who aren't serious usually end up as a drink name in my club.

set4-rogue-amendiares-261.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-rogue-amendiares-261.text: You got a table? I own the place, V. I can give you a table whenever I feel like it.

set4-rogue-amendiares-262.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-rogue-amendiares-262.text: Regret is a waste of time. I made the calls that kept me alive while others became legends. I can live with that.

set4-rogue-amendiares-263.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-rogue-amendiares-263.text: Rumors are the only thing that move faster than bullets in this city. If you have actual intel, give it to me. Otherwise, it's just noise.

set4-rogue-amendiares-264.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-rogue-amendiares-264.text: I got us to the destination in one piece. If you want a chauffeur, hire one. Otherwise, shut up and hold on.

set4-rogue-amendiares-265.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-rogue-amendiares-265.text: I've been doing this longer than you've been breathing, V. Just hurry up.

set4-rogue-amendiares-266.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-rogue-amendiares-266.text: Trusting the wrong people. Everything else is just a matter of firepower and planning.

set4-rogue-amendiares-267.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-rogue-amendiares-267.text: Then you don't need my help. You need a miracle. I don't work blind, and I don't take risks for secrets.

set4-rogue-amendiares-268.player: You have something on your face.
set4-rogue-amendiares-268.text: If it's not a bullet hole, I don't care.

set4-rogue-amendiares-269.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-rogue-amendiares-269.text: Then stop digging. Tell me exactly how deep you are, and we'll see if it's worth the price to pull you out.

set4-rogue-amendiares-270.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-rogue-amendiares-270.text: Important is a relative term. I was a solo who knew how to survive. Now I'm the one who decides who else gets to.

set4-rogue-amendiares-271.text: Set it down. Now tell me why you're really here.

set4-rogue-amendiares-272.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-rogue-amendiares-272.text: Which one? I don't take meetings just because someone asks. Give me a name and a reason.

set4-rogue-amendiares-273.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-rogue-amendiares-273.text: Keep it to yourself. I'm not interested in your subconscious.

set4-rogue-amendiares-274.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-rogue-amendiares-274.text: Curiosity. And I wanted to see if you were actually as capable as your reputation suggests.

set4-rogue-amendiares-275.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-rogue-amendiares-275.text: Either he's arrogant, or he knows something we don't. Which one do you think it is?

set4-rogue-amendiares-276.text: Don't bother. Just keep your head on straight and finish the job. That's the only thanks I value.

set4-rogue-amendiares-277.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-rogue-amendiares-277.text: Then find something louder to listen to. I don't have the patience for humming.

set4-rogue-amendiares-278.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-rogue-amendiares-278.text: It's the only plan that doesn't end with us in a body bag. If you have a better way to handle it, speak up now or get in the car.

set4-rogue-amendiares-279.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-rogue-amendiares-279.text: That is the way of this city, V. Most people are just passing through. Just make sure you stay on the right side of that statistic.

set4-takemura-280.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-takemura-280.text: I was considering the state of this city. It is a place of great energy, but it lacks a certain fundamental order.

set4-takemura-281.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-takemura-281.text: It is only a jacket. However, I would like to know what you were doing that required such a garment.

set4-takemura-282.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-takemura-282.text: I did not think it was a relevant detail for our current situation. But yes, I can. With the right ingredients, I could make a proper meal.

set4-takemura-283.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-takemura-283.text: Did you see who left it, or is it an anonymous note? Show it to me. We should determine if this is a genuine threat or merely an attempt to unsettle you.

set4-takemura-284.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-takemura-284.text: Like is not the word I would use. It is a chaotic place, and the food is an insult to the palate. But it is where the work is, and I have always valued purpose over comfort.

set4-takemura-285.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-takemura-285.text: I do not dwell on the past for the sake of sentiment. There were days in Chiba where the hunger was a constant weight and the air tasted of chemicals. But those days gave me the drive to be chosen. I do not regret the hardship that led me to my purpose.

set4-takemura-286.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-takemura-286.text: That is unnecessary. If you have a reason for it, you may speak, but I do not require apologies for the frictions of our alliance.

set4-takemura-287.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-takemura-287.text: It is a matter of discipline and observation. Most people look, but they do not actually see. I simply waited for the opening.

set4-takemura-288.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-takemura-288.text: Because the world does not reward those who are careless. I find that a certain level of gravity ensures that details are not overlooked.

set4-takemura-289.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-takemura-289.text: I am aware of the establishment's reputation. I only hope the menu contains something that was not synthesized in a vat.

set4-takemura-290.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-takemura-290.text: No. Arasaka gave me a life of discipline and a purpose to serve. To wish for a different path would be to deny the man I have become.

set4-takemura-291.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-takemura-291.text: Information travels quickly in this city, though it is often distorted. I would be curious to know who provided this report and what exactly they claim went wrong.

set4-takemura-292.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-takemura-292.text: I am a soldier, not a racer. My priority is the security of the passengers and the arrival at the destination, not the style of the transit.

set4-takemura-293.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-takemura-293.text: I have spent my life avoiding stupidity. I will be here.

set4-takemura-294.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-takemura-294.text: Danger is a relative term when one is trained for it. I suspect the most dangerous thing I have ever done was to accept the responsibility of protecting Saburo Arasaka. The risk was not merely to my life, but to my entire existence should I have failed.

set4-takemura-295.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-takemura-295.text: That is a difficult request. I can provide my assistance, but you must understand that I am operating blindly. If we are walking into a trap, I would prefer to know the nature of the enemy.

set4-takemura-296.player: You have something on your face.
set4-takemura-296.text: Where? I hope it is not a remnant of the local cuisine.

set4-takemura-297.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-takemura-297.text: That is a realization many in this city reach too late. Tell me the specifics of the situation. We will find a way to manage it, provided we act with a plan.

set4-takemura-298.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-takemura-298.text: Importance is a matter of perspective. I served as the personal protector to Saburo Arasaka. Whether that makes me important or merely a very efficient tool is for you to decide.

set4-takemura-299.text: I appreciate the gesture. I hope it is actual coffee and not some chemical substitute designed to mimic the taste.

set4-takemura-300.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-takemura-300.text: Very well. I will prepare. We should consider the location carefully before we agree to the meeting.

set4-takemura-301.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-takemura-301.text: I am not a man who finds much use for dreams. Unless it contained a tactical warning, I suspect it is a matter of little consequence.

set4-takemura-302.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-takemura-302.text: My reasons are my own, but they are rooted in a sense of duty. Whether that duty is to a person or a principle, the result remains the same. I am here because it is where I must be.

set4-takemura-303.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-takemura-303.text: He was not ignoring us. He was assessing us and decided that, for the moment, we were not a threat worth engaging. It was a calculated move.

set4-takemura-304.text: There is no need for formality. Your survival and our continued progress are the only thanks I require.

set4-takemura-305.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-takemura-305.text: I do not share this affliction. I find that focusing on the task at hand is the most effective way to clear the mind of such distractions.

set4-takemura-306.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-takemura-306.text: I am. If you find a flaw in the logic, I suggest you point it out now rather than during the execution.

set4-takemura-307.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-takemura-307.text: That is a heavy burden to carry. I may not be the companion you expected, but I am here. We will continue forward.

set4-viktor-vektor-308.player: What are you thinking about right now?
set4-viktor-vektor-308.text: Just thinking that the city is getting louder every year. Makes me appreciate the quiet in this clinic even more.

set4-viktor-vektor-309.player: I borrowed your jacket. Sorry about the stain.
set4-viktor-vektor-309.text: It is just a jacket, V. As long as you did not get any corporate blood on it, I can probably scrub it out.

set4-viktor-vektor-310.player: You never told me you could cook.
set4-viktor-vektor-310.text: I did not. But knowing how to keep a fighter fed is just as important as knowing how to patch them up.

set4-viktor-vektor-311.player: Someone left a threat at my door.
set4-viktor-vektor-311.text: That is a bad start to the day. Who is it, and did they leave a name or just a warning?

set4-viktor-vektor-312.player: Do you actually like it here?
set4-viktor-vektor-312.text: I do. Renting from Misty was one of the few decisions I actually got right. It is a good spot to work without the corporate noise.

set4-viktor-vektor-313.player: Tell me about the worst day of your life.
set4-viktor-vektor-313.text: I do not think about the worst days, V. I prefer to focus on the ones where I can actually make a difference. Keeps the head clear.

set4-viktor-vektor-314.player: I think I owe you an apology.
set4-viktor-vektor-314.text: You do not owe me a performance, V. If you have something to say, just say it.

set4-viktor-vektor-315.player: That was incredible! How did you do that?
set4-viktor-vektor-315.text: I cannot see what you are talking about right now. You will have to describe it to me.

set4-viktor-vektor-316.player: Why are you always so serious?
set4-viktor-vektor-316.text: When you spend your days digging around in people's nervous systems, you learn to value precision over punchlines. Does not mean I am not listening.

set4-viktor-vektor-317.player: I got us a table at the Afterlife.
set4-viktor-vektor-317.text: The Afterlife? I appreciate the thought, V, but I have spent enough of my life chasing status. I am perfectly happy right here.

set4-viktor-vektor-318.player: Do you ever wish you had chosen a different path?
set4-viktor-vektor-318.text: Used to care about who was important and how everything fit together. Dropped that race a long time ago and found I could sleep at night. I am fine where I am.

set4-viktor-vektor-319.player: I heard the Arasaka job went wrong.
set4-viktor-vektor-319.text: I have not heard anything about that. If it went wrong, you are the one standing here, so tell me what actually happened.

set4-viktor-vektor-320.player: You are a terrible driver, you know that?
set4-viktor-vektor-320.text: I am a ripperdoc, V, not a getaway driver. As long as we get to where we are going in one piece, I can live with your critique.

set4-viktor-vektor-321.player: I will be right back. Do not do anything stupid.
set4-viktor-vektor-321.text: I will be right here. Just try not to get yourself into any more trouble while you are gone.

set4-viktor-vektor-322.player: What is the most dangerous thing you have ever done?
set4-viktor-vektor-322.text: Probably stepping into the ring back in the day. There is a specific kind of danger when you are staring down someone who is just as determined as you are to win.

set4-viktor-vektor-323.player: I need your help, and I cannot tell you why.
set4-viktor-vektor-323.text: That is a difficult way to start a consultation. I can help you, but diagnosis gets messy when the patient keeps secrets. Just tell me what the symptoms are.

set4-viktor-vektor-324.player: You have something on your face.
set4-viktor-vektor-324.text: I cannot see what you are talking about. You will have to tell me where it is.

set4-viktor-vektor-325.player: I think I am in over my head.
set4-viktor-vektor-325.text: It happens to the best of us. Just take a breath and tell me what is going on. We can figure out a way to pull you back out.

set4-viktor-vektor-326.player: Is it true you used to be someone important?
set4-viktor-vektor-326.text: I used to think being important was the goal. Then I realized that letting go of that race was the only way I could actually get some sleep.

set4-viktor-vektor-327.text: I cannot see it, but I can smell it. Thanks, V. Just put it over there.

set4-viktor-vektor-328.player: The fixer wants to meet us tonight.
set4-viktor-vektor-328.text: I am not sure which fixer you mean. Unless they are coming here for a tune-up, I think I will pass.

set4-viktor-vektor-329.player: I had a dream about you last night.
set4-viktor-vektor-329.text: I hope it was a quiet one. I am not usually the kind of person people dream about unless they are worried about their chrome.

set4-viktor-vektor-330.player: Why did you really come with me?
set4-viktor-vektor-330.text: Because you are a friend, V. And sometimes a friend needs someone who knows how to patch them up when things go sideways.

set4-viktor-vektor-331.player: He looked right at us and just walked away.
set4-viktor-vektor-331.text: I cannot see who you are talking about. You will have to describe him to me.

set4-viktor-vektor-332.text: You do not need to, V. Knowing you are still walking and talking is thanks enough for me.

set4-viktor-vektor-333.player: That song is stuck in my head again.
set4-viktor-vektor-333.text: Happens to the best of us. Just keep your focus on the present, or you will be humming it all the way through your next job.

set4-viktor-vektor-334.player: You cannot be serious about this plan.
set4-viktor-vektor-334.text: I am serious about the risks. If you think the plan is flawed, tell me where it breaks before we start.

set4-viktor-vektor-335.player: Everyone I know is gone. Except you.
set4-viktor-vektor-335.text: That is a heavy burden to carry, V. I am still here. I am not going anywhere.

units.text: In my line of work, there is a big difference.
